mutants.label: stop converting ordering TypeErrors
mutants.why: Both ordering operators must translate an unorderable runtime value into the canonical ValidationError rather than leaking TypeError.

mutants.label: omit configured value from diagnostic
mutants.why: The runtime diagnostic must include both values so operators can identify the invalid comparison.

mutants.label: equivalent gte string comparison
mutants.why: Harmless control: equality is symmetric, so reversing the operands preserves behavior for every operator string.
